newsitem.title: USA: Roberds says court approves suit settlement.
newsitem.headline: Roberds says court approves suit settlement.

text.p: Roberds Inc said Wednesday that a U.S. District Court formally approved the settlement of the company's class action securities litigation.
The company said in a release that the settlement approval, which came on April 25, will "permit the disbursement of funds by the escrow agent later in 1997."

Originally filed early in 1994 in a federal district court in Dayton, Ohio, the shareholder class action suit against the company and certain of its officers was settled by Roberds in December of 1996.

Roberds and its insurers said in December 1996 they would pay $1.6 million in settlement, with the company paying $342,500, and the insurance carrier -- for its officers and directors -- paying $1,257,500.
In settling the case at that time, neither Roberds nor its officers admitted any wrongdoing or improper action.
